name: zvid_hw_api_driver_name
description: zVid::GetHwApiDriverName returns the driver-name field for a caller-validated hardware API table index.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4a7450 yet; the accessor currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a7450 validates a leaf return of &g_zVideo_HwApiDeviceTable[index].m_driverName with the 1772-byte record stride and no bounds check.
The native smoke verifies GetHwApiDriverName(2) returns g_zVideo_HwApiDeviceTable[2].m_driverName.
